summary: Change Agents Corporation filed an 8-K/A to correct a share-count error in its September 14, 2026 current report. The registrant issued $280,000 aggregate principal amount of 7% original issue discount notes maturing April 8, 2027 for $250,000 gross proceeds, plus pre-funded warrants for 100,000 shares. Net proceeds repay $39,420 of existing Vanquish Funding and June 2025 notes, with the remainder for working capital. The filing corrects September pre-funded warrant shares to 100,000 from 1,000,000. The notes carry negative covenants and a most-favored-nations clause. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation.
